title: solutions pro services weekly sync notes 2026-05-12
content:
Solutions + Pro Services Weekly Sync -- 2026-05-12
Time: 10:00am PT
Attendees: Ava Patel (owner), Marcus Li, Elena Rodriguez, Jonah Kim, Priya Singh, Riley Brooks, +1 (customer success observer)
Notes taken by: Ava Patel

Agenda:
- Quick cadence updates / outstanding action items
- Customer integration status (prioritized list)
- Blockers and escalation needs (SRE/security/legal)
- Resource and scheduling requests for next 2 weeks
- AOB (rollout windows, cert expiries)

TL;DR:
- Two customers (Acme Health, FinServCo) are in final validation; Acme is _on private deployment path_ and needs KMS/HSM keys + signed BAA before go-live.
- EduApp pilot is stable but needs additional latency optimization (quantization + batching) to hit SLOs for low-tier plans.
- RetailX rollout pushed due to network peering issues; SRE to review VPC routes and MTU mismatch.
- Action items created with owners and tentative due dates; no new P0s but several P1s that require legal/SRE follow-up by EOW.

Outstanding action items recap from last week:
- Marcus: finalize connectivity diagram for Acme Health VPC peering (done 2026-05-11).
- Elena: submit terraform PR for private deployment bootstrap (PR #322) (in review).
- Jonah: validate KV cache behavior under long chat sessions for EduApp (in progress).
- Priya: collect signed BAA template from legal for Acme (waiting on legal).

Deep-dive: Customer integration statuses

1) Acme Health (regulated healthcare customer)
- Current phase: Private deployment (VPC + on-prem control plane) — staging env up and smoke-tested 2026-05-08.
- Work completed:
  - Private control plane deployed to customer's VPC in us-west-2.
  - Model pinned to redwood/llama-3-70b-v2-quant for inference to reduce footprint.
  - Basic observability (per-route latency + token cost) wired to their Splunk destination.
  - Marcus delivered connectivity diagram, included CIDR ranges and peering flow.
- Blockers:
  - Legal: unsigned BAA and DPA. Business cannot sign off until BAA completed. (Priya -> legal).
  - Security: customer requires HSM-backed KMS integration (YubiHSM/HSM appliance) and we need credentials for provisioning.
  - Ops: certificate chain for mutual TLS expires 2026-05-19; needs rotation window scheduled.
- Risks & mitigation:
  - Risk: BAA delay pushes go-live beyond 2026-05-28 target. Mitigation: propose canary with redacted PHI (no real patient data) to validate latency/reliability earlier.
  - Risk: HSM onboarding could take 2+ weeks if vendor procurement is slow. Mitigation: offer soft KMS integration with strict audit logging for initial validation.
- Next steps & owners:
  - Priya: follow up with Legal for BAA and share draft by 2026-05-14.
  - Marcus: coordinate with SRE on cert rotation plan; propose 2026-05-18 maintenance window.
  - Elena: finish terraform PR (#322) and get infra team review by 2026-05-14.

2) FinServCo (financial services pilot)
- Current phase: final validation + load testing (dedicated capacity).
- Work completed:
  - Dedicated GPU pool provisioned in eu-west-1; throughput tests run at 80% of target (good).
  - Model variants tested: quantized redwood/opt-13b and non-quantized for high-accuracy flows.
  - Rollout policy configured: primary -> quantized model with fallback to non-quantized for specific endpoints.
- Blockers:
  - Compliance: they require SOC2 type-2 artifacts for our dedicated offering; security to provide artifact list.
  - Performance: some endpoints exceed latency SLO during batch peaks; we should tune continuous batching thresholds.
- Actions:
  - Jonah: run two 4-hour soak tests with real traffic replay and capture token-level traces (due 2026-05-15).
  - Riley: coordinate with CS to collect exact compliance checklist; escalate to security if items missing (due 2026-05-14).

3) EduApp (SaaS edtech, pilot)
- Current phase: pilot, N=500 users; feedback mostly positive.
- Observations:
  - Chat workloads have long context windows; KV cache hit rate ~62% — opportunity to tune prefix caching.
  - Latency target (95th pct < 350ms) currently at 410ms for 95th during peak.
- Proposed optimizations:
  - Apply more aggressive quantization for low-tier endpoints and enable smaller batch windows for interactive paths.
  - Configure model-specific batching and set cache TTLs to 30s for repeated prompt patterns.
- Actions:
  - Jonah & Elena: test quantization+batching config on staging and measure 95th pct latency improvement (due 2026-05-18).
  - Product: define degraded-quality threshold for auto-fallback to non-quantized model (Priya to coordinate).

4) RetailX (retail chain)
- Current phase: rollout prep; network integration testing failing intermittently.
- Symptom: packet drops and high retransmits between customer on-prem GW and our private connector; MTU mismatch suspected.
- Actions:
  - Marcus: open SRE ticket with packet captures + MTU hypothesis (JIRA-4621) (due 2026-05-13).
  - Riley: schedule on-call with customer network team for 2026-05-14 to test peering.

Cross-cutting items / Platform asks
- SRE: need a final review for Acme private deployment cert rotation and peering ACLs. ARC required for cert expiry plan. (Requested on Slack; escalate if no response by 2026-05-13).
- Security: provide list of artifacts required for FinServCo SOC2 review and HSM onboarding steps for Acme. (Riley to follow up).
- Product/Console: request minor Console change to surface model pin + rollout policy in customer-facing page (small UI tweak) — product-ops to triage.

Open questions / decisions needed
- Do we allow Acme to proceed with a 'redacted PHI' canary without signed BAA? Legal input required. (Priya -> legal)
- For FinServCo, acceptable latency tradeoffs for batch vs interactive endpoints? Product to confirm SLOs per endpoint.

Action items (new)
- Priya Singh: get BAA draft to Acme legal and copy solutions team (due 2026-05-14).
- Elena Rodriguez: merge terraform PR #322 (private bootstrap scripts) and coordinate with infra for secrets rotation (due 2026-05-14).
- Jonah Kim: execute load & soak tests for FinServCo and capture token-level traces (due 2026-05-15).
- Marcus Li: produce cert rotation maintenance plan + open SRE ticket for RetailX MTU investigation (JIRA-4621) (due 2026-05-13).
- Riley Brooks: collect SOC2 artifact checklist for FinServCo and schedule security sync (due 2026-05-14).
- Team: review and comment on Acme Confluence page (link above) before EOW.

Notes & context (snippets we referenced)
- Terraform PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/terraform/pull/322 (bootstrap scripts for private control plane)
- Confluence: Acme Health integration notes and network diagrams (linked above).
- Slack threads: #solutions-pro-services -> threads about HSM onboarding and cert rotation (search: "Acme HSM").

Parking lot (non-blocking / FYI)
- Consider offering a temporary managed KMS proxy for quicker HSM onboarding for regulated customers — pile in R&D backlog if multiple customers ask.
- Template for BAA/DPA to speed legal turnaround for healthcare customers (Priya to follow up).

Next meeting:
- Weekly sync next Tuesday 2026-05-19 10:00am PT. If there are escalations (Acme legal or RetailX network) we will add an interim touchpoint.

End of notes.
